independent_visual_review.method: Viewed saved comparison and stage images for exactly three fixed pilot components; no algorithm rerun or truth labels.

observations: 原增强图可见较连续、整体向右下弯曲的宽沟及叠加的更细斜股纹。
开运算移除了不少窄连接，但剩余前景呈串珠、短块状，不能直接称为纯绳间阴影。
D4新黄点仍在这些短块中出现密集、位置上下变化的排列；接受曲线中部有局部上下起伏及明显断段。
相比D3，部分右侧曲线能跟随较大的弯曲；但不能凭减少橙线或增加黄点推断识别准确率提升。
recommendations: 沿局部主切向统计支持持续性，而非把所有足够宽的块都当作有效宽沟。
抑制短尺度串珠形摆动，保留邻近长沟的平滑方向约束；无证据段继续拒绝。

observations: 中左部分增强后主要呈粗块、竖条和低信息暗区；右侧才有更清楚的重复绳纹。
Raw和Opened均保留大片纵向块状前景。开运算的宽度测试无法区分这种宽块与真实绳间沟。
新点出现在低信息区的零散块边。D4部分顶部及中部接受曲线缺乏图中可见的连续同向绳沟支持。
不能断言这些像素的真实边界位置；现有图只能支持低置信或未解析，而不能把块状变化解释成精确绳边。
recommendations: 原图局部方向一致性和多条近似周期绳沟证据不足时进入unknown/拒识。
不要仅增加阈值或开运算尺寸；宽块仍可通过且会损坏真实细窄沟。

observations: 左半部二值化宽条较连续，D4接受曲线总体顺着可见条纹。
靠右侧圆柱轮廓处，前景从长宽条变成短斜块并混入细股纹；新黄点散乱和曲线终止/分裂随之增多。
白色斜活动绳横跨区域未被整条拟合直接贯穿，是当前拒绝遮挡补线规则的正面表现。
右缘局部仍有短碎片，不能从其数学平滑或结构审计推定它们属于同一真实绳间沟。
recommendations: 在透视压缩区采用局部切向/法向尺度并要求沿切向支持持续；避免固定尺寸核全面加大。
继续把斜活动绳作为未知遮挡，不能用其亮体/阴影重新定义卷面相邻绳的身份。

independent_visual_review.method: Actual visual review of same three fixed component comparison and stage images; compare to viewed pilot001 and unchanged D3.0.1, no tuning.
independent_visual_review.conclusion: Broad groove extraction and rejection of low-information false support visibly improved. Middle/side fragments and local wavy tracks remain. Do not present structural passing or point counts as accuracy.
independent_visual_review.body_validation: All12 use saved float32 NPZ; no PNG-limited body validation cases.

method_changes: Fresh yellow candidates: coarse tangent averaging before adaptive threshold, width opening and raw-image bright flanks.
Projected coarse/fine texture periodicity diagnostic and independently estimated broad bright-body barriers.
New ordered local groups with pixel-path veto; old D2/D3 observations are not inputs.
Local robust fits plus monotonic derivative projection, variable-curvature integral, all-group-point vertical alignment.
Split and refit on body/unknown/long-evidence gaps; true raster ROI/unknown validation; no forced extrapolation.
known_limitations: Fine-strand crossings can still mimic wide grooves; morphology cannot guarantee pure inter-rope shadows.
Extreme dark block artifacts, side-edge foreshortening, partial shadow and competing phases remain uncertain.
Rejection reduces misleading long curves but can also remove correct boundaries and reduce coverage.
Current image-y convexity prior assumes this dataset camera orientation, not every future view.
Image-supported smooth curves, periodicity and audit success do not establish physical material identity or contact.
files_changed: New D4 directory and appended three navigation indexes only; all20 baseline files verified unchanged.
